_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/arvan/config.json and fill in your own values. NEVER put API keys or S3 secrets here, only the names of env vars that hold them. Domains, servers and regions are fetched live, so they are not listed here; only defaults, per-domain deploy hooks and notes live in this file.

notes.example.ir: Freeform per-domain reminder, e.g. 'active in panel but not published on public DNS, so DNS-01 is impossible until the zone is published'.
